name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: 'fd2_' game prefix + 'chapter_01' (chapter id 01 is a meaningful domain ID in the 1-30 range, must be preserved) + 'init' descriptor. The function is the chapter-1 init handler dispatched from the chapter init handler table (DATA xref @0x51d71, COMPUTED_CALL from fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher), so 'chapter_01_init' accurately reflects its role. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Chapter 1 init handler: plays the game's only full prologue (4 staged scenes) by walking current_chapter_id backward through three prologue map ids (0x20 -> 0x1F -> 0), then sets up the chapter-1 main battle (runtime chars, party-addition animations, NPC death) before handing control to the player.
logic_summary: Straight-line void orchestrator in four phases. Phase A (map 0x20): init battle state, pan camera, cutscene 0x63, two 15x/13x walk-up loops each followed by a dialog page (0/1), stop BGM, state=1 cutscene 0x64. Phase B (still map 0x20): pan, BGM 11, palette fade-in, dialog pages 2..5 chained with cutscenes 0x65..0x69 (last wrapped state=1). Phase C (map 0x1F): re-init battle state, load portrait sets 1/3/5, dialog pages 0..9 chained with cutscenes 0x5A..0x61, mark NPC slot 2 dead mid-run, stop BGM, state=1 cutscene 0x62. Phase D (map 0): init runtime chars 0/9/4/0x1E from base+growth, two party-addition appear animations with cutscenes 0/1/2 (200ms delays), mark NPC slot 9 dead, composite a battle frame, final dialog page, clear all facings, pan to char 0, zero party gold. data_fd2_battle_anim_phase is reset to 0 after most dialog pages; cutscene_event_state brackets the state=1 cutscenes. Leading __CHK(0x2C) is the Watcom stack-probe, not source body.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side-effect orchestrator that mutates chapter/battle globals and drives cutscene/dialog/animation subsystems.
